title: On Two-Player Scalar Discounted Linear Quadratic Games
summary: This paper studies feedback Nash equilibria (FNE) in scalar two-player discounted linear-quadratic games. By explicitly discounting the objective function, we reveal the existence of finite-cost equilibria that do not necessarily stabilize the system, motivating a distinction between stable FNE and FNE. We provide a sufficient condition ensuring that every FNE is stabilizing, together with an analytical characterization of the existence, uniqueness, and multiplicity of FNE.
